reader_summary.headline: Andy Golden is the President of Princeton University's Investment Management Company (PRINCO).
reader_summary.overview: Andy Golden is the President of Princeton University's Investment Management Company (PRINCO). Having grown from $3B at the time of his arrival in 1995 to $22.5B today. Andy came to PRINCO from Duke Management Company, where he was an Investment Director.

key_points.text: Having grown from $3B at the time of his arrival in 1995 to $22.5B today.
Andy came to PRINCO from Duke Management Company, where he was an Investment Director.
Andy currently serves on the fund Advisory Boards of several well-known private equity and venture capital managers, including Bain Capital, General Catalyst Partners.
